proof_body:
by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have h3 : Real.cos (3 * (Real.pi / 9)) = 4 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 9) ^ 3 - 3 * Real.cos (Real.pi / 9) :=
    Real.cos_three_mul _
  have h4 : 3 * (Real.pi / 9) = Real.pi / 3 := by ring
  rw [h4, Real.cos_pi_div_three, ← hq] at h3
  have hr : (8 : ℚ) * q ^ 3 - 6 * q - 1 = 0 := by
    have : (((8 : ℚ) * q ^ 3 - 6 * q - 1 : ℚ) : ℝ) = 0 := by push_cast; linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hdq : (q.den : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast q.den_nz
  have hint : (q.num * 2) ^ 3 - 3 * (q.num * 2) * (q.den : ℤ) ^ 2 - (q.den : ℤ) ^ 3 = 0 := by
    have : ((q.num : ℚ) * 2) ^ 3 - 3 * ((q.num : ℚ) * 2) * (q.den : ℚ) ^ 2 - (q.den : ℚ) ^ 3 = 0 := by
      have e : (q.num : ℚ) = q * q.den := (Rat.mul_den_eq_num q).symm
      rw [e]
      have : (q * q.den * 2) ^ 3 - 3 * (q * q.den * 2) * (q.den : ℚ) ^ 2 - (q.den : ℚ) ^ 3
          = (q.den : ℚ) ^ 3 * (8 * q ^ 3 - 6 * q - 1) := by ring
      rw [this, hr]; ring
    exact_mod_cast this
  have hcop : IsCoprime q.num (q.den : ℤ) := by
    rw [Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]
    exact q.reduced
  obtain ⟨d, hdd⟩ : ∃ d : ℤ, d = (q.den : ℤ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by rw [hdd]; exact_mod_cast q.den_pos
  rw [← hdd] at hint hcop
  have hdvd : d ∣ 8 := by
    have h1 : d ∣ q.num ^ 3 * 8 := ⟨3 * (q.num * 2) * d + d ^ 2, by linear_combination hint⟩
    exact (hcop.pow_left (m := 3)).symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h1
  have hdle : d ≤ 8 := Int.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdvd
  have hnd : q.num ∣ d ^ 3 := ⟨(q.num ^ 2 * 8 - 6 * d ^ 2), by linear_combination -hint⟩
  have hnu : IsUnit q.num := (hcop.pow_right (n := 3)).isUnit_of_dvd' dvd_rfl hnd
  rcases Int.isUnit_iff.mp hnu with h | h <;> rw [h] at hint <;> interval_cases d <;> omega
